MEDTECS INTERNATIONAL CORPORATION LIMITED  
(Incorporated in Bermuda) 
 
COMPLETION OF THE DISPOSAL OF RMKH GLOVE (CAMBODIA) CO., LTD. 
 
 
The Board of Directors (“ Board”) of Medtecs International Corporation Limited (the 
“Company”, and together with its subsidiaries, the “ Group”) refers to the Company’s 
announcement dated 10 April 2026 (the “ Announcement”) in relation to, inter alia, the  
proposed disposal of the Group’s entire equity interest in RMKH Glove (Cambodia) Co., Ltd. 
(“RMKH Cambodia”) to Shijiazhuang Hongray Group Co., Ltd. (“Hongray”) (the “Disposal”). 
 
Unless otherwise defined, all capitalised terms used in this announcement shall bear the 
same meanings ascribed to them in the Announcement. 
 
Further to the Announcement, the Board is pleased to announce that the Disposal has been 
completed on 9 October 2026. The full Consideration of US$ 13,144,512 has been received 
by the Company, while 100% of RMKH Cambodia shares has been transferred to Hongray. As 
mentioned in paragraph 5.3 of the Announcement, following completion of the Disposal, the 
RMKH Indebtedness will remain owing by RMKH Cambodia to the Group and will not be 
novated or waived. As at completion date, the RMKH Indebtedness amounted to US$20.7 
million. Please refer to paragraph 5.4 of the Announcement for details on the repayment of the 
RMKH Indebtedness.  
 
BY ORDER OF THE BOARD 
Clement Yang Ker-Cheng 
Chairman – Executive Director 
9 October 2026 
 
 
This announcement has been reviewed by the Company’s sponsor, PrimePartners Corporate 
Finance Pte. Ltd. (“Sponsor”). It has not been examined or approved by the Singapore 
Exchange Securities Trading Limited (the “Exchange”) and the Exchange assumes no 
responsibility for the contents of this announcement, including the correctness of any of the 
statements or opinions made or reports contained in this announcement.
